=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

RIVEN:

Use the provided Riven reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve Riven's exact facial identity, facial structure, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and armor design, sword design, overall silhouette, and grounded warrior appearance.

Riven must remain unmistakably the same character throughout the entire video.

This scene takes place many years after Riven's childhood, before she leaves home to join the army.

Her original character design must remain unchanged.

Do not redesign her costume.

Do not change her hairstyle.

Do not change her body proportions.

Do not replace or redesign her sword.

Riven has practiced swordsmanship for many years.

She is fast, physically capable, confident, disciplined, and highly skilled.

Her movement must remain grounded and human.

She has already made the private decision to leave home.

She has not yet told her father directly.


FATHER:

Use the provided Father reference image as the strict primary visual reference for Riven's father.

Preserve his recognizable facial appearance, age, hairstyle, facial hair, body proportions, clothing design, and grounded former-warrior appearance.

He is an experienced former warrior.

His swordsmanship is economical, calm, precise, and extremely efficient.

He relies on timing, positioning, leverage, footwork, and experience rather than speed or brute force.

He knows Riven's fighting habits extremely well.

He also knows his daughter well enough to understand that something has changed in her.

Do not make him frail.

Do not make him clumsy.

Do not portray him as overly emotional.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided village/home reference as the environmental reference.

The entire scene takes place continuously in the familiar dirt-and-grass training area beside Riven's family cottage.

Maintain the recognizable family home:

weathered timber-and-stone construction,
rough stone foundation,
sloped roof,
small chimney,
wooden door,
nearby chopping block,
stacked firewood,
simple fence,
large old tree,
and open training space beside the cottage.

The surrounding village remains peaceful.

Rugged mountains rise beyond the green valley.

Natural late-afternoon daylight.

Gentle mountain wind.

No army appears.

No additional characters are needed.

Do not change location.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural human movement.

Grounded physical interaction.

Realistic sword weight.

Realistic weapon contact.

Realistic cloth and hair physics.

Maintain strict facial identity, costume consistency, weapon consistency, and body proportions throughout the whole video.

The sparring choreography must look like two highly familiar training partners.

Keep every sword exchange clear and physically readable.

The father defeats the exchange through timing and technique, not overwhelming strength.

Riven must still look highly skilled even when she is disarmed.

No rapid montage.

No exaggerated slow motion.

No impossible acrobatics.

No spinning for spectacle.

No supernatural abilities.

No magical effects.

No glowing weapons.

No injury.

No blood.

This is controlled sparring between father and daughter.

All character dialogue must be spoken in natural ENGLISH ONLY.

Use clear natural English pronunciation.

Every written dialogue line must be spoken verbatim by the specified character.

Do not translate the dialogue.

No Chinese or Mandarin.

No Vietnamese.

No Japanese.

No Korean.

No other spoken language.

No additional spoken dialogue.

No background intelligible conversations.

Accurate visible lip synchronization whenever a character speaks.

No narration.

No voice-over.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Adult Riven and her father are sparring in the familiar training yard.

Both already have their swords drawn.

Riven is performing extremely well.

She has become skilled enough to genuinely pressure her father.

The father responds by changing the rhythm of the exchange.

Riven commits to an attack.

Instead of meeting her strength directly, the father moves away from the attack line, redirects her blade, and uses controlled leverage to disarm her.

Riven's sword falls into the dirt.

The sparring immediately stops.

Neither character is injured.

Riven looks at her fallen sword and then at her father.

She says:

"I thought I had you."

Father answers:

"You did."

Riven is slightly confused by the answer.

A quiet understanding passes between them.

Father knows Riven intends to leave home.

He does not ask why.

He does not try to stop her.

He asks only:

"When?"

Riven understands exactly what he means.

She answers:

"Tomorrow."

Father accepts the answer without argument.

He looks toward Riven's sword lying in the dirt.

Then he tells her:

"Pick it up."

Riven walks toward the sword.

She bends down and reaches for it.

End while Riven is physically picking the sword up from the ground.


=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — PRESSURE

Open directly on Adult Riven and her father already engaged in controlled sparring.

Riven attacks with confidence.

Her father blocks.

Their swords meet with realistic weight.

Riven immediately changes angle.

Another exchange.

Riven remains balanced and controlled.

She presses forward.

Father gives ground only when necessary.

Riven catches one of his counters and redirects it.

She steps into a strong position.

For a moment, Riven appears to control the exchange.

Father recognizes her pressure.

His expression remains calm.

Then he changes his rhythm.

Riven expects another immediate response.

It does not come.

She commits to the opening.

Father moves.


Shot 2 — DISARM

Father steps cleanly outside Riven's attack line.

He does not overpower her.

He redirects her sword with a compact movement.

Riven immediately attempts to recover.

Father catches the recovery through timing and leverage.

Their swords make one final controlled contact.

Riven's weapon is knocked from her hands.

Her sword falls into the dirt several steps away.

CLANG.

Riven instinctively begins to move after it.

Father does not attack.

He immediately lowers his own sword.

Riven stops.

Silence.

She looks at the sword on the ground.

Then back at her father.

She catches her breath.

Riven says:

"I thought I had you."

Father looks directly at her.

He answers:

"You did."

Riven's expression changes slightly.

She does not fully understand what he means.

Father gives no explanation.


Shot 3 — WHEN?

The physical tension of the sparring is gone.

Father lowers his sword completely.

Riven remains facing him.

A quiet pause.

Father studies his daughter.

He has noticed the change in her.

He asks simply:

"When?"

Riven immediately understands the question.

Do not have her ask what he means.

Do not explain the subject verbally.

Riven holds his gaze.

She answers:

"Tomorrow."

Silence again.

Father absorbs the answer.

No shock.

No anger.

No disappointment.

No emotional speech.

He already suspected she intended to leave.

His eyes move toward Riven's sword lying in the dirt.

Riven follows his gaze.

Father looks back at her.

He says:

"Pick it up."


Shot 4 — PICK IT UP

Riven looks toward her fallen sword.

She walks across the training yard.

Father remains where he is.

He watches quietly.

Riven reaches the sword.

She bends down.

Close on Riven's hand approaching the grip.

Her fingers close firmly around it.

Riven begins lifting the sword from the dirt.

Keep the movement deliberate and visually clear.

Hold the composition on Riven retrieving the weapon.

Father remains visible farther behind her if composition allows.

No one speaks again.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven remains in the training yard beside her family cottage.

She has told her father that she intends to leave tomorrow without explicitly explaining the decision.

Her father understood immediately.

There was no argument.

There was no goodbye.

There was no discussion about whether she should leave.

Riven's sword was disarmed during sparring and fell into the dirt.

The final action is Riven bending down, gripping the sword, and beginning to lift it from the ground.

Her father remains behind her in the training yard.

Neither character leaves the location.

End immediately after Riven picks up the sword.


=== MOOD ===

Grounded.

Controlled.

Restrained.

Physical.

Quietly decisive.

The relationship between Riven and her father should be communicated through familiarity rather than sentimentality.

The progression is:

Riven pressures Father
→ Father changes rhythm
→ controlled disarm
→ sword falls
→ "I thought I had you."
→ "You did."
→ quiet recognition
→ "When?"
→ "Tomorrow."
→ Father accepts the decision
→ "Pick it up."
→ Riven retrieves her sword.

Do not include the army.

Do not include soldiers.

Do not show Riven leaving home.

Do not show travel equipment.

Do not change to another location.

Do not change to another day.

Do not include a goodbye.

Do not include Father's final lesson about who Riven fights for.

That conversation has not happened yet.

End with Riven picking up the sword.

This scene takes place many years after Riven's childhood, before she leaves home to join the army.

Her original character design must remain unchanged.

Do not redesign her costume.

Do not change her hairstyle.

Do not change her body proportions.

Do not replace or redesign her sword.

Riven has practiced swordsmanship for many years.

She is fast, physically capable, confident, disciplined, and highly skilled.

Her movement must remain grounded and human.

She has already made the private decision to leave home.

She has not yet told her father directly.


FATHER:

Use the provided Father reference image as the strict primary visual reference for Riven's father.

Preserve his recognizable facial appearance, age, hairstyle, facial hair, body proportions, clothing design, and grounded former-warrior appearance.

He is an experienced former warrior.

His swordsmanship is economical, calm, precise, and extremely efficient.

He relies on timing, positioning, leverage, footwork, and experience rather than speed or brute force.

He knows Riven's fighting habits extremely well.

He also knows his daughter well enough to understand that something has changed in her.

Do not make him frail.

Do not make him clumsy.

Do not portray him as overly emotional.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided village/home reference as the environmental reference.

The entire scene takes place continuously in the familiar dirt-and-grass training area beside Riven's family cottage.

Maintain the recognizable family home:

weathered timber-and-stone construction,
rough stone foundation,
sloped roof,
small chimney,
wooden door,
nearby chopping block,
stacked firewood,
simple fence,
large old tree,
and open training space beside the cottage.

The surrounding village remains peaceful.

Rugged mountains rise beyond the green valley.

Natural late-afternoon daylight.

Gentle mountain wind.

No army appears.

No additional characters are needed.

Do not change location.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural human movement.

Grounded physical interaction.

Realistic sword weight.

Realistic weapon contact.

Realistic cloth and hair physics.

Maintain strict facial identity, costume consistency, weapon consistency, and body proportions throughout the whole video.

The sparring choreography must look like two highly familiar training partners.

Keep every sword exchange clear and physically readable.

The father defeats the exchange through timing and technique, not overwhelming strength.

Riven must still look highly skilled even when she is disarmed.

No rapid montage.

No exaggerated slow motion.

No impossible acrobatics.

No spinning for spectacle.

No supernatural abilities.

No magical effects.

No glowing weapons.

No injury.

No blood.

This is controlled sparring between father and daughter.

All character dialogue must be spoken in natural ENGLISH ONLY.

Use clear natural English pronunciation.

Every written dialogue line must be spoken verbatim by the specified character.

Do not translate the dialogue.

No Chinese or Mandarin.

No Vietnamese.

No other spoken language.

No background intelligible conversations.

Accurate visible lip synchronization whenever a character speaks.

No narration.

No voice-over.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Adult Riven and her father are sparring in the familiar training yard.

Both already have their swords drawn.

Riven is performing extremely well.

She has become skilled enough to genuinely pressure her father.

The father responds by changing the rhythm of the exchange.

Riven commits to an attack.

Instead of meeting her strength directly, the father moves away from the attack line, redirects her blade, and uses controlled leverage to disarm her.

Riven's sword falls into the dirt.

The sparring immediately stops.

Neither character is injured.

Riven looks at her fallen sword and then at her father.

She says:

"I thought I had you."

Father answers:

"You did."

Riven is slightly confused by the answer.

A quiet understanding passes between them.

Father knows Riven intends to leave home.

He does not ask why.

He does not try to stop her.

He asks only:

"When?"

Riven understands exactly what he means.

She answers:

"Tomorrow."

Father accepts the answer without argument.

He looks toward Riven's sword lying in the dirt.

Then he tells her:

"Pick it up."

Riven walks toward the sword.

She bends down and reaches for it.

End while Riven is physically picking the sword up from the ground.


=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — PRESSURE

Open directly on Adult Riven and her father already engaged in controlled sparring.

Riven attacks with confidence.

Her father blocks.

Their swords meet with realistic weight.

Riven immediately changes angle.

Another exchange.

Riven remains balanced and controlled.

She presses forward.

Father gives ground only when necessary.

Riven catches one of his counters and redirects it.

She steps into a strong position.

For a moment, Riven appears to control the exchange.

Father recognizes her pressure.

His expression remains calm.

Then he changes his rhythm.

Riven expects another immediate response.

It does not come.

She commits to the opening.

Father moves.


Shot 2 — DISARM

Father steps cleanly outside Riven's attack line.

He does not overpower her.

He redirects her sword with a compact movement.

Riven immediately attempts to recover.

Father catches the recovery through timing and leverage.

Their swords make one final controlled contact.

Riven's weapon is knocked from her hands.

Her sword falls into the dirt several steps away.

CLANG.

Father does not attack.

He immediately lowers his own sword.

Riven stops.

Silence.

She looks at the sword on the ground.

Then back at her father.

She catches her breath.

"You did."

Riven's expression changes slightly.

She does not fully understand what he means.

Father gives no explanation.


Shot 3 — WHEN?

The physical tension of the sparring is gone.

Father lowers his sword completely.

Riven remains facing him.

A quiet pause.

Father studies his daughter.

He has noticed the change in her.

He asks simply:

"When?"

Riven immediately understands the question.

Do not have her ask what he means.

Riven holds his gaze.

Silence again.

No shock.

No anger.

No disappointment.

No emotional speech.

He already suspected she intended to leave.

His eyes move toward Riven's sword lying in the dirt.

Riven follows his gaze.

Father looks back at her.

He says:

"Pick it up."


Shot 4 — PICK IT UP

Riven looks toward her fallen sword.

She walks across the training yard.

Father remains where he is.

He watches quietly.

Riven reaches the sword.

She bends down.

Close on Riven's hand approaching the grip.

Her fingers close firmly around it.

Riven begins lifting the sword from the dirt.

No one speaks again.

Riven remains in the training yard beside her family cottage.

Her father understood immediately.

Restrained.

Physical.
